name: Microsoft Forms
description: Microsoft Forms is Microsoft's survey, quiz, poll, registration, and questionnaire service for personal, education, and organizational use. People create forms, choose who can respond, collect answers through links or embeds, review results, and export response data for further analysis.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft Forms cannot currently be connected directly to Relay agents because Microsoft publishes no supported production account API for forms and responses; its limited Forms connector runs only inside Microsoft-managed Power Automate, Logic Apps, and Copilot Studio workflows.

blocked.label: Connect a Microsoft Forms account
blocked.description: Microsoft does not publish a supported production Microsoft Forms OAuth or direct account API contract that Relay can register and distribute.

blocked.label: Use forms and responses
blocked.description: Microsoft Graph has no production form or response content resource; its beta adminForms resource controls tenant-wide settings only and is explicitly unsupported for production applications.

blocked.label: Repurpose the Microsoft Forms workflow connector
blocked.description: Microsoft documents the Forms connector only for Microsoft-managed Power Automate, Logic Apps, and Copilot Studio workflows, not as a general endpoint or credential contract for third-party applications.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported production Microsoft Forms account API, delegated OAuth contract, user-owned API credential, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported production Microsoft Forms account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported production Microsoft Forms account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft publishes no supported production API for creating, listing, reading, or changing Microsoft Forms and their responses. The Microsoft Forms connector exposes only form details, response details, and a response trigger inside Microsoft-managed Power Automate, Logic Apps, and Copilot Studio products; it is not documented as a distributable third-party API. Microsoft Graph's only Forms-specific resource is beta tenant administration settings, which Microsoft says must not be used for production dependencies.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect or request a Microsoft token for Forms. Reconsider only if Microsoft publishes a supported production Forms content API or remote MCP service, or explicitly exposes its Forms connector for independently registered third-party applications. A customer-authored Power Automate workflow should be treated separately as that customer's automation, not as direct Microsoft Forms authorization.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents its Forms connector as available only in Copilot Studio, Logic Apps, and Power Automate. It works only with organizational accounts and exposes two read actions plus a response-submitted trigger, not a general form-management API for third-party applications.
Microsoft's supported Microsoft Graph v1.0 API reference and live metadata contain no Microsoft Forms content entity set for forms, questions, or responses.
The beta adminForms resource covers company-wide Forms configuration only, and Microsoft explicitly states that beta APIs are unsupported for production applications.

Microsoft instructs customers to create and own a Power Automate flow that selects a form, triggers on a response, and fetches response details; this is a customer-managed workflow rather than a direct Forms developer API.
Microsoft describes Forms as a product for creating surveys, quizzes, and polls, controlling respondent audiences, and collecting responses through links and other sharing methods.
